nearest_work.distinction: The scalar factor-three theorem and the inherited four-call residue endpoint are already solved. This package optimizes all two-by-two integer lifts using the cross-row residue lattice and a fixed Euclidean metric.

Exact refined dyadic algebraic response capacity and a full two-by-two matrix census. The present reader matrix is a member of that census, but fixed coarse-output rounding and the global lift minimax are additional.
Supplies the general rounded four-call dirty restoration and phase-image method. These are reused and explicitly credited, not claimed as new.
Exact dyadic Smith-factor capacity. The present fixed-box Euclidean rounded error differs under non-isometric Smith charts.
Dyadic two-wire orthogonal/unitary approximation floors. This package uses the fixed nonunit determinant-five reader and integer coarse outputs.
Rounded connector doubling carries and source-query restoration. The present global residual-lattice minimax is a different contract.
Exact integer dirty-fanout operation tariff for demand (5,12). The present result is a rounded approximation-error optimum in a fixed four-block architecture.
All-precision feasibility for rational strict affine systems. The present minimax has an explicit rounded endpoint, arbitrary dirty phases and an attaining reversible program.
